name: Holiday Leftover Homemade Turkey Carcass Bone Broth & Egg Noodle Soup
whyItWorks: Simmering the holiday turkey frame releases gut-soothing glycine, proline, and gelatin; combined with shredded turkey breast, peeled soft-boiled carrots, and tender egg noodles or white rice, it helps your gut recover after rich holiday meals.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Strain the turkey broth through a fine mesh sieve, chill and skim off the solid yellow fat cap, then simmer with shredded turkey breast, peeled sliced carrots, and egg noodles or white rice.
watchOuts: Skim the rendered turkey fat off the top of the broth and strain out fibrous celery strings and onion skins
